sign: Dyers' town of Corvane. Home of the cartographers' guild.
guard: Gatekeeper Ansel: The moor and the pond paths are guild business since the storm.
Gatekeeper Ansel: Show Ysolde at the guild house what you can do, then I'll let you through.
vats: Dye vats, cold and grey. Nobody has stirred them since the colour went out.

lines: Trader Lorna: Brews and bandages. The colour may be gone, but bruises are still blue.

lines: Dyer Nell: By day my hands are blue to the elbow. By the spring at dusk they're almost clean.
Old Oskar: Every evening the same faces at the spring. I wouldn't trade a single one.
Weaver Fenna: The guild bell rings, and half of Madderby comes to the spring to talk about the other half.
